# DOV test fixtures

Borehole and interpretation XML from DOV, the subsurface database of Flanders, kept byte for byte as DOV serves them
(`https://www.dov.vlaanderen.be/data/boring/<key>.xml` and `…/data/interpretatie/<key>.xml`):

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `boring-1931-084105.xml` | Borehole kb15d28w-B187, Antwerp |
| `boring-1948-120680.xml` | Borehole kb15d28w-B292, Antwerp |
| `boring-2016-147736.xml` | Borehole kb15d28w-B100, Antwerp |
| `interpretatie-2023-372137.xml` | Formal stratigraphy of kb15d28w-B187 |
| `interpretatie-2023-372255.xml` | Formal stratigraphy of kb15d28w-B292 |
| `interpretatie-2023-373973.xml` | Formal stratigraphy of kb15d28w-B100 |
| `interpretatie-2016-252597.xml` | Lithological description of kb15d28w-B100 (in French) |

Source: Databank Ondergrond Vlaanderen (DOV), Flemish Government; consulted on 07/10/2026, on
https://www.dov.vlaanderen.be. DOV data may be reused free of charge, commercially or not, under the Flemish
government's model licence for free reuse (Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik), which asks for this attribution. The
Apache-2.0 licence of this repository does not apply to these files.
